proof_body:
by
  intro V P _ _ _ _ A B C D H hc h1 h2
  have hmul := EuclideanGeometry.mul_dist_eq_mul_dist_of_cospherical hc h1.wbtw.mem_affineSpan h2.wbtw.mem_affineSpan
  have hHD : dist D H ≠ 0 := dist_ne_zero.mpr h2.ne_right.symm
  have hang : EuclideanGeometry.angle A H C = EuclideanGeometry.angle D H B := by
    rw [EuclideanGeometry.angle_eq_angle_of_angle_eq_pi_of_angle_eq_pi (EuclideanGeometry.angle_eq_pi_iff_sbtw.mpr h1) (EuclideanGeometry.angle_eq_pi_iff_sbtw.mpr h2), EuclideanGeometry.angle_comm]
  have h3 := EuclideanGeometry.dist_mul_of_eq_angle_of_dist_mul D H B A H C (dist A H / dist D H) hang (by field_simp) (by field_simp; linarith)
  rw [dist_comm H D, dist_comm H A, h3]
  field_simp
target_source: ∀ (V P : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace ℝ V] [MetricSpace P] [NormedAddTorsor V P] (A B C D H : P), EuclideanGeometry.Cospherical ({A, B, C, D} : Set P) → Sbtw ℝ A H B → Sbtw ℝ C H D → dist A C * dist H D = dist D B * dist H A
